summary: Iteration 4 (attachments, member invite, budget alert, weekly-summary cron) tested end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases in test_iteration4.py PASS — attachment upload (200), included in GET /api/tasks/{id}.attachments, download via Bearer header and ?auth= query (200), unauth 401, non-member 403 on private task file, 15MB rejection 400, soft-delete 200 + 404 on subsequent download; invite creates status='invited' user without exposing invite_token/password_hash, member 403 on invite, duplicate 400, GET /api/invite/{token} returns {email,name,org_name}, unknown token 404, POST /invite/{token}/accept sets password + returns {user, token}, subsequent login works, token single-use (404 on reuse); budget alert endpoint returns 200 on under-budget and crossing (email is best-effort); cron/weekly-summary: missing/wrong secret 401, correct secret 200 {ok:true}; /app/.emergent/crons.yml valid (weekly-summary, '0 9 * * 1', Europe/Istanbul, POST endpoint). Frontend (Playwright as owner on public URL): Bisiklet task drawer 'Dosya Ekleri' section shows attachment-upload-btn/file-input, upload produces attachment-<id>, download and delete testids appear, delete removes the item and 'Dosya yüklendi' toast fires. Members page invite-member-btn → invite-dialog with name/email/role → 'Davet bekliyor' badge and invited email appear in list. /davet?token=badtoken renders error state as expected.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — carried over from iteration 3, not user-visible but pollutes console.

action_items: LOW: Fix Radix DialogTitle/Description a11y warnings across drawer + dialogs (carried over from iter 3).

PRE-EXISTING (not iter 4): WebSocket handshake returns 403 (wss ..../api/ws/...?token=...) — realtime broadcasts silently fail in preview. UI still refreshes via re-fetch after mutations so functional flows work, but real-time attachment/budget updates depend on this. Investigate ws auth in preview ingress.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py grew to 1132 lines (up from 942). Definitely time to split into resource-specific routers (attachments, invite, cron, budget) — the 700-line threshold has been exceeded by 60%.

download_file uses HTTPException(401) but a browser <a href=.../download?auth=X> would still bounce to a JSON error page on failure. Consider returning a small HTML error page for browser downloads when auth invalid.

_budget_alert_if_crossed only checks 'not previously exceeding' at the item mutation boundary, so mass import via multiple POSTs each just under budget followed by one crossing item will correctly fire once — good. But bulk-imports done in a single POST are not supported yet (N/A).

invite_member: `existing = await db.users.find_one({'email': email})` doesn't scope by org_id, so inviting an email that already exists in ANOTHER org (if multi-tenant grows) will 400. Add org_id scoping when multi-org is enabled.
accept_invite doesn't invalidate any prior sessions of the invited user (not applicable since 'invited' users have no password anyway, but worth noting for security review).
storage.put_object/get_object are synchronous requests wrapped in run_in_threadpool at call sites — good. Timeout=120s is reasonable for 15MB uploads.
